step.name: Step 1: Define Your Objectives and Budget
step.text: Start by thinking about what you want to achieve with your renovation and how much you're comfortable spending. Are you looking for a simple refresh or a complete overhaul? This initial clarity helps guide all subsequent decisions and ensures the project aligns with your financial expectations.

step.name: Step 2: Measure and Design the Space
step.text: Precise measurements are critical. This is where you'll map out your new layout, considering fixtures, cabinetry, and accessibility. We help develop designs that maximize both functionality and aesthetics, ensuring everything fits perfectly and looks amazing.

step.name: Step 3: Confirm Fixtures and Materials
step.text: Once the design is set, it's time to choose the specific fixtures and materials – from toilets and sinks to tiles and lighting. It's important to consider compatibility, durability, water usage, and maintenance. We guide you through selecting options that meet your needs and vision.

step.name: Step 4: Obtain Required Approvals and Permits
step.text: Depending on the scope of your renovation, you may need local permits. This step ensures your project complies with all local, state, and national requirements, particularly if structural, plumbing, or electrical changes are involved. LineWork Development handles the coordination for these approvals.

step.name: Step 5: Demolition and Rough-In Work
step.text: This phase involves removing old fixtures and preparing the space. Rough plumbing and electrical are installed according to the new design, ensuring all necessary connections are in place before walls are closed up.

step.name: Step 6: Waterproofing and Finishes
step.text: Waterproofing is crucial in bathrooms, especially around showers and tubs, to prevent future issues. Following this, wall and floor finishes are installed, bringing your design to life with your chosen tiles, paint, and other surfaces.

step.name: Step 7: Fixture and Cabinetry Installation
step.text: Finally, the new fixtures, custom cabinetry, and hardware are installed. This is when the bathroom truly starts to take its final form, with everything meticulously placed and connected.

step.name: Step 8: Final Inspection
step.text: A final inspection ensures all work meets quality standards and regulatory requirements. This is also when any last touches or adjustments are made, completing your brand new bathroom. Ready to get started on your bathroom renovation? LineWork Development is here to guide you through every step. Call us at (626) 594-5005 to discuss your project.
